units: <cite ref="Shabbat 32b:9">Sabb. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>בעוון ג׳ וכ׳</he> as a punishment for the crime of oppression, the locust rises &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 4:1">Am. IV, 1</cite> a.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:5">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, beg. <he>שׁטופים בזימה ובג׳</he> steeped in lust and violence.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113b">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> Canaan bequeathed to his sons … <he>אהבו את הג׳</he> love ye violence.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 80b:5">B. Kam. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>אין בו משום ג׳</he> the law of robbery does not apply to it (it is not private property).
<cite ref="Eruvin 100b">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> we should have learned <he>ג׳ מנמלה</he> the regard of property from the ant.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 109a:6">B. Kam. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיוציא גְּזֵילוֹ וכ׳</he> until he dispossesses himself of his robbery.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 109b:9">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>גזילו יוצא וכ׳</he> his robbery must go out of his possession.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:3">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> <he>גזילו של גוי וכ׳</he> what has been illegitimately taken from a gentile, is forbidden (must be restored).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:2:4">Y. Gitt. IV, 45ᶜ</cite> <he>מפני ג׳ השבט</he> in order to protect the (priestly) tribe from loss; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 2:1:15">Y. Orl. II, 61ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מפני גיל השבט</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
